messages.author: fiona.ferrier.100657@bramblewickcenterfor.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the Pacific Northwest Chapter space. We have our regional conference coming up in Seattle this May and I want to make sure the agenda covers our local milling concerns.

messages.author: charlotte.ashcroft.101920@homestead.example
messages.text: Thanks Jiwoo. I can help coordinate the tasting room volunteers if the events team sends over the final roster by next Friday.

messages.author: jamie.fuller.000113@postfield.example
messages.text: The Portland delegation is driving up together on Wednesday morning. Let me know if anyone needs extra space for transporting cooler bins.

messages.author: fiona.ferrier.100657@bramblewickcenterfor.example
messages.text: Given the current health announcements, we are postponing our spring tasting event. I am waiting on guidance from ICF staff regarding refund policies for registered attendees.

messages.author: charlotte.ashcroft.101920@homestead.example
messages.text: We are pivoting our retail orders to curbside pickup only for now. Has anyone heard if the certification exams are moving to an online format?

messages.author: karen.diallo.102051@quillbrookdairyinstitute.example
messages.text: Production has slowed down due to supply chain delays on packaging materials, but we are managing. Eunji says the virtual training modules are actually quite well attended.

messages.author: carmen.torres.101398@birchmoorfinecheese.example
messages.text: The virtual symposium schedule looks solid. Nora notes that the session on raw milk microbiology has generated a lot of sign-ups from our student members.

messages.author: charlotte.ashcroft.101920@homestead.example
messages.text: People keep asking when we will resume in-person chapter dinners. I think we should aim for a small outdoor gathering in October if local rules permit.

messages.author: fiona.ferrier.100657@bramblewickcenterfor.example
messages.text: In-person events are finally back on the calendar and competition entries for the regional awards are double what we saw in prior years. Make sure your submissions are in before the portal locks.

messages.author: jamie.fuller.000113@postfield.example
messages.text: We are completely sold out of our summer washed rind batches already. Capacity is really being tested across all our vats right now.

messages.author: charlotte.ashcroft.101920@homestead.example
messages.text: The venue contract for the autumn conference is signed and sealed. We secured the larger hall in downtown Portland to accommodate the extra vendors.

messages.author: fiona.ferrier.100657@bramblewickcenterfor.example
messages.text: Sponsorship commitments for this year are holding steady, but our volunteer committees are stretched thin. If your creamery has an apprentice who wants to help out, let me know.

messages.author: duarte.greco.101904@thistlemerecheeseco.example
messages.text: Energy costs and milk prices are putting a real squeeze on margins this winter. Several smaller producers are looking closely at the hardship dues waiver offered by ICF.

messages.author: fiona.ferrier.100657@bramblewickcenterfor.example
messages.text: We are organizing a succession planning workshop for next month to help retiring makers connect with younger cheesemakers looking to take over existing operations.

messages.author: charlotte.ashcroft.101920@homestead.example
messages.text: Costs have finally started to stabilize around the region, which is a huge relief for our purchasing budgets. Membership renewals for the second quarter are looking very healthy.

messages.author: jamie.fuller.000113@postfield.example
messages.text: The discussion on modernizing raw-milk aging rules is the main topic at our next committee meeting. I will post a summary of the proposed changes once we review the draft text.

messages.author: fiona.ferrier.100657@bramblewickcenterfor.example
messages.text: Traceability standards are tightening up across the board, so make sure your lot coding systems are up to date before the fall audit cycle begins.

messages.author: charlotte.ashcroft.101920@homestead.example
messages.text: Our final chapter meetup of the year is locked in for November. Jiwoo will send out the formal invitation and RSVP link by the end of the week.
